verdict.rationale: Render documents ephemeral previews of the entire application architecture for every change, defined through a single Blueprint YAML. It also documents isolation that keeps non-production environments from reaching production services. Together these support parallel per-change environments for a team. Missing for 10: evidence that environments are truly unlimited (no stated concurrency limits or cost details), in-depth docs on how preview environments are isolated and managed, and independent or hands-on corroboration of team-scale parallel use.
